ui.title: FarmBot Lab
ui.subtitle: Program the drone to look after the farm
ui.console.empty: What happens during the run shows up here.
help.title: How to play
help.step1: The code, right below, is the commands for the drone. It follows one command per line, from top to bottom. Lines that start with // are notes for you: the drone ignores them.
help.step2: Click Run. The farm starts over from scratch and the drone follows the commands.
help.step3: Watch the drone work on the farm. The console, at the foot of the page, tells what happened and warns you if there is an error. The number in brackets is the tick at which each thing happened.
help.step4: Too slow? Choose 4×, 16× or Instant: the result is the same, it only goes by faster. Pause holds the farm, and the same button lets it go on.
help.step5: Change the code and click Run again. Reset clears the farm and the console without running anything. Your code stays where it is.
help.ticks: Each command takes time, measured in ticks. The meter shows how much the run spent: the fewer ticks, the better the code.
help.commands.title: Commands the drone understands
help.cmd.move: goes one cell: Dir.NORTH (to the back of the screen), Dir.EAST (to the right), Dir.SOUTH (to the front) or Dir.WEST (to the left)
help.cmd.plant: plants in the drone's cell: Plant.GRASS or Plant.WHEAT (wheat needs tilled soil and hay in stock)
help.cmd.harvest: harvests the plant in the drone's cell (if it is not ready yet, it is lost)
help.cmd.till: tills the drone's cell (if it is already tilled, it goes back to grass)
help.cmd.wait: waits the given number of ticks, for example 130
help.cmd.log: writes whatever is between the parentheses to the console
help.cmd.random: gives a random number between 0 and 1
help.cmd.getPos: tells which cell the drone is in
help.cmd.getSize: tells the size of the field
help.cmd.getPlant: tells which plant is in the drone's cell
help.cmd.isReady: tells whether the plant in the drone's cell is ready to harvest
help.cmd.getTerrain: tells whether the drone's cell is grass or tilled soil
help.cmd.getStock: tells how much is in stock: Item.HAY or Item.WHEAT
help.bilingual: Every command also works in Portuguese (for example, mover instead of move).
console.started: Run started. The farm started over from scratch.
console.empty: The code is empty. Write a command, for example move(Dir.EAST); and click Run.
console.trimmed: (Older lines were removed to make room.)
console.destroyed: The plant was harvested before it was ready and was lost. Wait longer, or use isReady(), which tells whether the plant can be harvested yet.
console.bumped: The drone tried to leave the field and stayed where it was.
reject.occupied: the cell already has a plant.
reject.needs-tilled-terrain: this plant needs tilled soil. Use till() first.
reject.not-enough-hay: there is not enough hay in stock. Harvest grass to get hay.
